record.reason: The full text’s active GUI task-state memory helps long-horizon agent execution, but its experiments report task success, not reductions in inference tokens, calls, latency or memory. The paper mentions screenshot downsampling for lower visual-token/training cost, which is a data/training choice rather than the agent-memory method’s measured runtime benefit. Retain as borderline because agent memory could affect inference workload but the claimed connection is not established.
record.title: What Memory Do GUI Agents Really Need? From Passive Records to Active Task-Driving States
